function: Symbol-level-precoding dual-functional waveform design: SLP-Inception-Net maps CSI and symbols to a constant-modulus precoding vector minimizing beampattern MSE under multi-user QoS constraints (p. 5-7).
system: Monostatic MIMO-ISAC: BS with M=10 ULA (lambda/2 spacing), Ku=3 or 4 single-antenna users, Kt=3 targets, QPSK, LoS radar, Rayleigh users; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3-4, 9).
method: SLP-Inception-Net (CNN with Inception module, phase-based activation): supervised pre-training on PDD-MM-BCD solutions, then unsupervised gradient-based fine-tuning (hybrid-driven); Adam, batch 100, learning rate 0.001 (p. 6-9).
data_channel: Simulated Rayleigh user channels, LoS radar; labels from PDD-MM-BCD optimizer solutions on generated CSI and symbols; dataset size not stated; no 3GPP or measured data (p. 4, 7).
test_conditions: Training versus test conditions not stated; results swept over SINR threshold, users Ku and radar samples N; generalization claimed but no cross-setting test is described (p. 11-12).
baselines: Non-learned: SSP, SDR (block-level), PDD-MM-BCD, ALM-RBFGS (symbol-level optimization). Learned: fully connected DNN and AlexNet CNN, unsupervised, at similar FLOPs (p. 10).
metrics: Beampattern MSE, detection probability versus false alarm probability, target angle RMSE, symbol error rate, average execution time, FLOPs and parameters, training and validation loss (p. 9-14).
complexity: SLP-Inception: 855.52 kMac FLOPs, 27.4k parameters (Table I, p. 10); average execution time about 1000 times shorter than PDD-MM-BCD (Fig. 10, p. 13).
q1_support: p. 4: "the Rayleigh fading channel between the BS and the k-th communication user"; custom simulator, and no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "highlighting the excellent generalization performance and robustness"; but the paper never says a model trained at one Ku, SINR threshold or setting is tested at another, and Table I layer sizes depend on Ku (p. 10).
q3_support: p. 10: "a traditional DNN composed of multiple fully connected layers" and AlexNet, compared in MSE, detection, RMSE and SER (p. 11-13); SSP, SDR, PDD-MM-BCD and ALM-RBFGS are the non-learned baselines.
q4_support: p. 13: "approximately 1000 times shorter" average execution time than PDD-MM-BCD (Fig. 10); Table I (p. 10) lists FLOPs of 855.52 kMac and 27.4k parameters.
q5_support: p. 7: "to construct a standard dataset" from its own optimizer solutions on simulated channels; no link, DOI or public dataset, and the only URL is an author homepage in a biography (p. 15).
notes: Area 5: SLP waveform design serving communication and radar beampattern in a monostatic ISAC BS. ris=0: no RIS in the system. Borderline q2: generalization across Ku and the SINR threshold is claimed (p. 11-12) but training versus test settings are never stated, and the hybrid-driven fine-tuning (p. 7-8) refines the network on the same setting, so q2=0. q3 rests on the DNN and AlexNet comparisons at equal FLOPs (p. 10-13).
